reviewer: ponte_formal, delegated integration review; did not author integrated report
scope: One review round; source pins, stored score integration, covariance formulas, custody chronology and claim scope. No injection generation or re-fit.
limitations: Review checks integration, custody and hashes; it does not independently reproduce the source paper, every raw-data construction or experimental systematics.
Source files containing observations were hashed as bytes only; no observed local centers parsed or fitted.
Gauss-Newton BG, published covariance structure, q0/j0 and conditional independence remain assumptions. Missing off-diagonal physical terms remain OPEN.
D>5 is expected separation, not five-sigma observed detection or guaranteed power. Free-Cepheid model has about62.4% power.
Four independent RNG stream groups are corroborated from generator source and released seed-key groups; no secret seeds opened or RNG rerun.
Original FREEZE is historical; its two superseded pins are explained by POST_FREEZE_CHANGE and FREEZE_R2, not treated as current validation failures.
readiness: Integrated report is reviewable/deliverable with its declared scope. This is not empirical confirmation, canonical promotion, or authority to move gate.
